tasks.title: Add installAgents() to init.ts
tasks.description:
Add an `installAgents()` function to `src/commands/init.ts`, mirroring the existing `installSlashCommands()` function (lines 323-341).

1. Create `installAgents(projectRoot: string, ralphRoot?: string): void` — same signature pattern as `installSlashCommands`
2. Resolve ralph root via `ralphRoot ?? resolveRalphRoot()`
3. Build source path: `path.join(root, 'agents')`
4. If source dir doesn't exist, return silently
5. Read all `.md` files from source dir
6. Build dest path: `path.join(projectRoot, '.claude', 'agents')`
7. Create dest dir with `fs.mkdirSync(destDir, { recursive: true })`
8. Copy each file, logging `Installed: .claude/agents/<filename>`
9. Call `installAgents(projectRoot)` from `runInit()`, right after the `installSlashCommands(projectRoot)` call
10. Export `installAgents` for testing

tasks.title: Update init tests to cover agent installation
